race.comment: TOMOYUKI (6) is another unraced gelding with a strong case, having trialled a close second at Gold Coast Poly. Trial was a little slower than others on the day, though he's shown enough ability to suggest he can play a major role. ZOULINI (11) resumes after a six-month break and her debut fifth at Gold Coast Poly had merit after racing wide throughout; a solid second in her latest trial and the 1.5kg claim make her a realistic danger if she has furnished. TRAMCA (7) brings the best recent race form of the exposed runners, beaten just under two lengths when third at Eagle Farm after being hampered early and held up near the 400m. Can fire in this easier assignment. SPIRIT OF ASIA (10) was solid on debut and looks better suited out in trip.
